entries.en: The technician disabled AFC briefly to check how far the oscillator's frequency had drifted.
entries.zh: 技术员短暂关闭自动频率控制，以检查振荡器的频率漂移了多少。

entries.en: Replacing the damaged cable improved the SNR enough for the receiver to recover the message.
entries.zh: 更换损坏的电缆后，信噪比得到改善，接收机终于能够还原报文。

entries.en: The archive reader handled FB records correctly but failed on variable-length records.
entries.zh: 归档读取程序能正确处理固定块格式的记录，却无法处理变长记录。

entries.en: A jammed cartridge stopped the MSF while the operator was retrieving the file.
entries.zh: 操作员正在调取文件时，一个卡住的存储盒使海量存储装置停止了运行。

entries.en: The laboratory postponed the alloy trial because its supply of Gd had not arrived.
entries.zh: 实验室因所需的钆尚未到货，推迟了合金试验。

entries.en: The bank tested its TP system before moving the accounts to the new server.
entries.zh: 银行在把账户迁移到新服务器之前，测试了事务处理系统。

entries.en: The analyst found more Na in the second soil sample than in the first.
entries.zh: 分析人员发现，第二份土壤样品中的钠比第一份更多。

entries.en: The engineer asked the foundry to increase the proportion of Bi in the alloy.
entries.zh: 工程师要求铸造厂提高合金中铋的比例。

entries.en: The installer traced the dead telephone line to a disconnected pair at the MDF.
entries.zh: 安装人员沿着失效的电话线路排查，发现主配线板处有一对线断开了。

entries.en: A cracked HIC kept the guidance unit from starting.
entries.zh: 一块开裂的混合集成电路使导航单元无法启动。

entries.en: The repairer found that a failed DAC had left the amplifier without an analogue input signal.
entries.zh: 维修人员发现，一个失效的数模转换器使放大器失去了模拟输入信号。

entries.en: The parser rejected the expression because it did not match the BNF grammar.
entries.zh: 解析器拒绝了该表达式，因为它不符合巴科斯-诺尔范式语法。

entries.en: The developer reproduced the crash in a clean VM before changing the main installation.
entries.zh: 开发人员在修改主安装环境之前，先在一台干净的虚拟机中复现了崩溃。

entries.en: The historian traced the measurement procedure to an old NBS report.
entries.zh: 历史学家追查后发现，该测量程序源自美国国家标准局的一份旧报告。

entries.en: The microphone picked up a faint tone at 12 kHz during the test.
entries.zh: 测试期间，麦克风拾取到了一个12千赫的微弱音调。

entries.en: The haematology team could not compare the CSF results because the laboratories had used different assays.
entries.zh: 由于各实验室采用了不同的检测方法，血液学团队无法比较集落刺激因子的检测结果。

entries.en: Moving the heavy toolbox forward shifted the aircraft's CG.
entries.zh: 把沉重的工具箱向前移动后，飞机的重心发生了变化。

entries.en: The mobile app stopped loading the timetable after the provider changed its API.
entries.zh: 服务提供方更改应用程序接口后，这款手机应用就无法加载时刻表了。

entries.en: TG showed a gradual loss of mass as the dried sample was heated.
entries.zh: 热重法显示，干燥样品在加热过程中质量逐渐减少。

entries.en: The review board returned the SCR because it lacked a rollback plan.
entries.zh: 审查委员会因系统更改请求中缺少回退计划而将其退回。

entries.en: The sequence contained Thr immediately after the lysine residue.
entries.zh: 该序列中，苏氨酸紧接在赖氨酸残基之后。
